subject: Marketing RFP — SeamlessAccess
body:
Dear SeamlessAccess Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I came across your RFP seeking a Marketing & Outreach Consultant to support your efforts in audience segmentation, messaging refinement, content planning, and campaign execution within the global research and library community. Your mission and focus on professionalizing these efforts resonate strongly with our team's expertise in strategic marketing for organizations serving specialized audiences.

We'd love the opportunity to learn more about your goals for this project and explore how we might contribute to its success. Could you kindly share any next steps or details regarding the submission process? If helpful, we'd be happy to schedule a brief call to discuss the scope further.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

subject: Website RFP — Accountability Lab
body:
Dear Accountability Lab Team,

I hope this note finds you well. I recently came across your RFP for the redesign and rebuild of the Accountability Lab website, and I wanted to express our interest in this exciting opportunity. The focus on improving user experience, accessibility, multilingual support, and performance aligns closely with the type of work we're passionate about.

We also appreciate the emphasis on seamlessly migrating from your current CMS, integrating donation and newsletter platforms, and creating a refreshed design system that reflects your visual identity. It's clear this project plays a critical role in supporting your global mission, and we'd be honored to contribute to its success.

Could you please share any additional details about the next steps in the process, or let us know if there's an opportunity to discuss your vision further?

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
